data.description: Easy Access | Parking on Front | Ready to Move
data.long_description:
This beautifully designed 3-bedroom townhouse with a maid’s room is located in the sought-after Rukan Lofts community. Offering a contemporary layout, generous living spaces, and a private garden, this home is perfect for individuals, couples, or professionals seeking a stylish and peaceful retreat in a well-connected location.

Property Details:

BUA: 1,150.88 sq. ft.
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 4 
Maid’s Room with en-suite
Unfurnished – ready for your personal touch
Private Front Garden – ideal for relaxing or entertaining
Direct Parking right in front of the unit
Open-Plan Living – bright and airy layout
Built-in Wardrobes and high-quality finishes

Interior Highlights:

Elegant Marble Flooring in living areas
Warm Wooden Flooring in bedrooms
Large Windows that fill the space with natural light
Open Kitchen with modern fittings
Brand New Construction – move-in ready

Community Features:

4 Community Swimming Pools
Fully Equipped Gym
Shops & Retail Centre within walking distance
Parks, jogging, and cycling trails
Gated Community with 24/7 Security

Location Benefits:

Easy access to E611 and E311 highways
Close to malls, schools, and entertainment hubs
Peaceful surroundings with community views

Key Features Summary:

Built-In Wardrobes
Maid’s Room with En-Suite
Balcony
Air Conditioning
Brand New / Newly Built
Open Kitchen
Fitness Centre Access
Secure, Gated Community
Electricity & Utilities Ready

This townhouse offers an ideal blend of comfort, style, and convenience in one of Dubai’s emerging residential hotspots. Schedule your viewing today and make this modern home your own.
